The '''Calline system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] at grid coordinates Q-18 and contained a [[Calline system's star|yellow-orange star]] orbited [[Calline system's first planet|by]] [[Calline system's second planet|three]] [[Calline system's third planet|planets]]. The system was located in a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] distant from major trading routes.
